# Luminate

> Luminate is a web design and custom software company based in Augusta, Georgia, serving businesses, ministries, and nonprofits across the CSRA (Central Savannah River Area). One founder handles each project start to finish — design, build, hosting, and ongoing management.

## Services

- Website Design & Build — custom, mobile-first sites for businesses that have outgrown DIY builders and templates
- Custom Business Software — client portals, dashboards, booking systems, and internal tools built around how a business actually works
- Ongoing Management — hosting, security, updates, and SEO handled after launch

## Pricing

- Launch — $750+ starting, $50/mo Website Care — professional 1–3 page website
- Growth — $1,500+ starting, $50/mo Website Care — larger conversion-focused site with lead capture, booking tools, etc.
- Custom Systems — $3,500+ starting, System Care from $125/mo — applications, portals, e-commerce, automations, and integrations
- Personal Website — $350 — simple portfolio, résumé, or personal-brand website for individuals (not for business/revenue-generating sites)

## Pages

- [Home](https://luminatewebdesign.com/): services, pricing, selected work, and contact form
- [Web Design Augusta GA](https://luminatewebdesign.com/web-design-augusta-ga): local web design landing page for Augusta and CSRA businesses
- [Client Portal](https://luminatewebdesign.com/portal.html): login-only client dashboard for existing clients — not a content page
